#     Table_S7_CTCF_peak_signal.csv. Signal is the mean of the deposited spike-in
#     normalised bigWig over the union component
#     There is NO per-peak p-value: two libraries
#   RNA_<class> = avg_log2FC (mutant vs wild type) WITHIN that cell class
#     Within-class values are used precisely because they cannot be produced by a
#     shift in cell-type proportions. avg_log2FC is NOT composition-adjusted.
#   padj_<class> = p_val_adj for the same comparison.
# EMPTY CELL = gene detected in <10% of that class's cells in both genotypes
#   absent from the DE table (Seurat min.pct = 0.1). Drawn grey with a dash; never zero.
# GENE SELECTION: selection axis is ChIP
#   circular. Pool entry required: promoter = ENCODE forebrain H3K4me3 (E16.5
#   ENCFF965GZP) AND ChIPseeker Promoter<=3kb; nearest RefSeq TSS <=2 kb; ChIP
#   wt_norm_signal >= 3.0; RNA padj < 0.05; sign of ChIP_log2FC agrees with peak_class
#   (42.1% of GAINED-class peaks fail this: class is from peak CALLING
#   signal QUANTIFICATION). Genes were then chosen by biological category membership
